root_cause.text: The VBIOS record-chain parsing loops in `bios_parser.c` and `bios_parser2.c` lack an upper bound on iterations, relying solely on a terminator record (0xFF sentinel or zero size) to exit, which leads to unbounded loops and out-of-bounds reads when parsing a malformed VBIOS image.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces infinite `for (;;)` loops with bounded loops capped at `BIOS_MAX_NUM_RECORD` (256) iterations across multiple parsing functions, and the commit message states that "A malformed VBIOS image missing the terminator record causes unbounded iteration at probe time... [and] struct casts beyond the 2-byte header validated by GET_IMAGE can also read out of bounds."
